title: Eyedropper for painting: Alt-pick in the Paint tools, and a Pick in the Flows' paint step
description: Fabio 2026-09-17: in the IMAGE history workspace, while a Paint tool is active, holding Alt temporarily turns the cursor into a colour picker; clicking samples the canvas colour into the paint colour, releasing Alt returns to painting. Reuse what MPI-771 built: js/utils/colourKeyMask.js readImagePixels / cornerColour and the native EyeDropper pattern in MpiToolOptionsMaskColour. Paint colour lives in toolSettings.paint.color. Alt must go through Hotkeys.bind + hotkeyRegistry.js (no raw keydown). FOLDED IN, Fabio 2026-10-01 (screenshot of Scribble's "Draw it" step): the Flows' paint step has no eyedropper either. MpiStepPaint (the `paint` step kind, used by Scribble and Draw It In) mounts a bare MpiColorPicker (MpiStepPaint.js:533); MpiColorField already pairs that picker with a Pick button on the native EyeDropper API and five tool panels use it - swap it in, and give the drawing canvas the same Alt-pick as the history Paint tools. See brief.md.
